caveats: The Q4 value is derived (full-year capex less the nine-month year-to-date figure), not a directly reported quarterly figure.

claims.text: Apple's fiscal Q4 2024 capital expenditures (payments to acquire property, plant and equipment) were about $2.908 billion, derived as FY2024 $9,447,000,000 minus nine-month $6,539,000,000 = $2,908,000,000.

raw_output.summary: Apple's capital expenditures (payments to acquire property, plant and equipment) in fiscal Q4 2024 (2024-06-30 to 2024-09-28) were about $2.908 billion. This is a derived figure: $9,447,000,000 for the full fiscal year minus $6,539,000,000 for the first nine months.
